title: 政府公开三维数据参考层
sample: 逸夫科学大楼及周边 160 × 115 m
summary: 青色：LandsD 官方建筑壳体；土色：CEDD DTM；橙点：CEDD DSM。
轮廓重叠率 85.3%；投影质心差 2.37 m（含形状差，非平移建议）。
现有主屋顶 111.60 m；参考换算值 114.40 m HKPD。
源高程垂直语义待核：不作垂直换算时 111.60 m，差约 2.80 m。
官方壳体为统一平顶，未表达现有两端设备结构；保留细化主模型。
建筑/道路外地面差中位数 -0.12 m（显示地形−DTM，含人工整坡）。
黄色框：当前建筑；蓝色框：参考壳体。未应用任何主模型修改。

sourceHeightConversion.method: Official geodetic API at four sample corners, linear plane of HKPD minus WGS84 ellipsoidal height; center independently checked. This assumes ECEF source altitude is ellipsoidal and remains explicitly switchable because source vertical semantics are not documented.
sourceHeightConversion.horizontalPipeline: Inverse of Hong Kong 1980 to WGS 84 (1) + Hong Kong 1980 Grid (with axis order normalized for visualization)

governmentBuilding.owner: 香港特别行政区政府地政总署
governmentBuilding.epochNote: tilesetVersion1.2.3 is a format/version identifier; no survey/imagery acquisition date provided for this component.
governmentBuilding.selection: 4 JSON indices +14 bounded leaves, 434473 bytes total offline; only matched building is shipped.

cedd.owner: 香港特别行政区政府土木工程拓展署

sources.attribution: © 香港特别行政区政府地政总署 / 土木工程拓展署；现有校园轮廓 © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL).

matching.method: Highest intersection-over-union of XY union of projected official triangles against existing OSM building footprint. Next candidate IoU < 0.013; no name or nearest-center guess.
matching.confidence: high geometric identity, no official university-name attribute

footprint.note: Reference is full projected building geometry, including overhangs; current comparison is OSM shell footprint, not legal/cadastral footprint. Centroid delta includes shape difference, not a recommended rigid translation.

height.CEDDStatus: 2020 LiDAR DSM already used by current model correction; not independent proof.
height.officialRoofStatus: Uniform flat top. Does not resolve end equipment and stepped roof; vertical semantic of API source not explicitly stated beyond WGS84.

terrain.method: Current preserved 1m terrain grid bilinear heights vs native 0.5m DTM center values sampled every1m; excludes building +3m, separately roads+3m. DTM under buildings is interpolated bare earth, not ground floor.

roads.method: Existing road triangle centers vs nearest 1m subset of native DTM, scoped to sample. Difference may indicate constructed grade, bridge, retaining works or epoch; not automatic road error. Distances use horizontal road-top triangle union.

metrics.decision: Retain existing Blender and local detailed building. Flag footprint edges, terrace/road grading and vertical datum ambiguity for field/photo checks; no blind resize, translation or terrain reset.
